import pandas as pd

# Load source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source4_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_85/training_4.csv"
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_85/training_1.csv"

df_source4 = pd.read_csv(source4_path, index_col=0)
df_source1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, index_col=0)

# Operation 1: JOIN Source5_85_4 and Source5_85_1 on "Ord_id"
df_joined = pd.merge(df_source4, df_source1, how="inner", left_on="Ord_id", right_on="Ord_id")

# Operation 2: group_by = [] (no grouping columns), aggregations = [sum(Source5_85_4.Sales)]
# Since no group_by columns, aggregate sum of Sales over the entire joined dataframe
total_sales = df_joined["Sales"].sum()

# Create the target dataframe with the required schema and name
# Target schema: ['Sales': float]
df_target = pd.DataFrame({"Sales": [total_sales]})

# Write the result to the specified path
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_85/target_multisource.csv"
df_target.to_csv(output_path, index=False)

import pandas as pd

# Read source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_85/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_85/training_1.csv", index_col=0)
source2 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_85/training_2.csv", index_col=0)
source3 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_85/training_3.csv", index_col=0)
source4 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_85/training_4.csv", index_col=0)

# Join Source5_85_4 with Source5_85_1 on Ord_id
df = pd.merge(source4, source1, how='inner', left_on='Ord_id', right_on='Ord_id')

# Join the result with Source5_85_0 on Ship_id
df = pd.merge(df, source0, how='inner', left_on='Ship_id', right_on='Ship_id')

# Join the result with Source5_85_2 on Cust_id
df = pd.merge(df, source2, how='inner', left_on='Cust_id', right_on='Cust_id')

# Join the result with Source5_85_3 on Prod_id
df = pd.merge(df, source3, how='inner', left_on='Prod_id', right_on='Prod_id')

# Aggregate sum of Sales (no group by since target has only Sales column)
result = pd.DataFrame({'Sales': [df['Sales'].sum()]})

# Write output to the target file
result.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_85/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
